question: Separate direct-reference access of the planning/coding agent from original-image conditioning of image_gen.

agent_factor: A1 receives and must directly view reference.png. A0 receives no original-image file/path and must use identical reference-derived textual specifications. A0 is not a no-reference-knowledge claim.
image_factor: Controller forces original reference input on every successful image_gen call for G1, and never for G0. Planner is not told G assignment. Optional unmodified earlier own raw outputs are allowed in both. num_last_images_to_include is prohibited.
mechanical_relay: All four conditions use the same file-based request_image.py. A narrow fresh GPT-6-Astra/max relay session forwards the exact literal prompt and assigned image inputs to the actual built-in image_gen tool; it does not plan or rewrite prompts. Relay must view supplied local images before calling. Planner never receives relay original images, reference paths, or relay observations. Exact prompt/reference arguments and runtime outputs are audited. Relay overhead is recorded and counts toward the global session limit and planner wall-clock budget.
generation_budget: GPT-6-Astra/max; 35 minutes including gateway waiting; at most3 attempted image requests and6 complete renders. Max2 concurrent planners, at most1 image relay, and a shared global limit3 for ALL planners/relays/reviews.
evaluation: Same 120-reference detailed checks and 3% full-scale /3 percentage-point tolerance. First full-render attempt, including failure, and last usable render; identical image reused within trial. All available final images receive a second independent review. No scores fed back. Each review15min, max1 technical retry, no generation resampling.
secondary_fidelity: 0..4 preservation scores for nondata identity, nondata pose/relations, composition hierarchy, material/style; inapplicable=null. Explicitly exclude allowed data/semantic changes. Does not alter existing pass thresholds.
review_blinding: Reviewers receive original reference and same current text/data/core, exact image and necessary rendering assets/code. Do not receive arm labels, image-request folders, relay traces, planning instructions or intervention input.json. Visible output/source may still suggest condition; no claim of perceptual masking.
randomization: Interleaved conflict-family case blocks, random within-stratum selection; four-condition Latin rotations each used6times; opaque trial IDs, frozen before calls. No model-level deterministic sampling seed is claimed.
launch_gate: First case four conditions run before the remaining92 tasks. Advance based on actual reference routing compliance and transport completion, NEVER on pass rate. Infrastructure/protocol failure holds the queue with preserved attempts.
denominators: Each arm24 planned trials for first/final end-to-end rates, all96 pooled also shown. Technical missing/partial/fail/uncertain are not passes. Image-quality and reference-routing compliance are shown separately. Four-arm complete protocol-verified cases form paired effect analysis; exclusions listed.
analysis: Primary endpoints joint_supported and joint_visible_supported at final. Four conditional factor contrasts per endpoint; exact McNemar and conservative CP difference intervals. Holm correction across8prespecified tests. Main effects and interaction are computed per reference, no pseudoreplication. Interaction conservative95% interval uses simultaneous bounds for4discordant probabilities. Formal tests only after study closure. Fidelity and costs descriptive; one run per cell, model reviewers, no human-reader validation.
